name: Saudi Cabs GMC
description: Private taxi and chauffeur service operating across Saudi Arabia — Makkah, Madinah, Jeddah, Taif, and intercity routes to Riyadh and Dammam. Fixed prices agreed before travel, airport transfers, Hajj & Umrah transport, and private driver hire.
servicesOffered: Ziyarat tours (Makkah and Madinah historical sites)
pricingModel: Fixed price agreed before travel via WhatsApp — no meter, no surge pricing
accessNote: The central areas of Makkah and Madinah (around Masjid al-Haram and Masjid an-Nabawi) are restricted to Muslims only, per Saudi regulations, regardless of transport arrangements.
